source_text: Si peccaverit in sanctis Domini, addet quintam partem. Restitutio cum incremento. Gratia non fraudem nutrit. Amen.
thought_title: Restitution with increase for sins against holy things
orientation: Origen is explaining the Levitical rule that one who sins against the Lord's holy things must make restitution plus a fifth.
pass_a_gloss: If [he] will have sinned in [the] holy [things] of [the] Lord, [he] will add [a] fifth part. Restitution with increase. Grace [does] not nourish fraud. Amen.

choices.why: The glossary sense of sanctus as set apart for God; the plural refers to consecrated things, not persons.
Literal rendering of the legal penalty; keeps the future tense and the precise fraction.
Keeps the present tense and the personification; grace is the subject, fraud the object.

bible_refs.note: Si peccaverit in sanctis Domini, addet quintam partem

pass_b_english: If someone has sinned against the holy things of the Lord, he shall add a fifth part (Leviticus 5:16). Restitution with increase. Grace does not nourish fraud. Amen.
